findings.summary: The new HistoryRow open affordance navigates to /people/:id/events/:eventId, but no screen declares that route; screen.logContact only covers /people/:id/events/new, so the revision destination is a broken reference.
findings.evidence: effects: [Navigates to /people/:id/events/:eventId to revise the event] vs. screen.logContact route: /people/:id/events/new (no other screen has an :eventId route)

findings.summary: The screen-composition fixture now claims to cover the /people/:id/events routes, but the event-revision route has no defined screen, states or composition to verify.
findings.evidence: fixture: "protected browser fixture over all screens incl. /people/:id/events routes"

findings.summary: The added revise-event affordance has no link to any operation or screen for revising, so the revise path for operation.contact.log ('Log or revise contact') is not reachable through a specified form.
findings.evidence: affordance.HistoryRow.open has no invokes/navigates link; only affordance.ContactEventForm.save invokes operation.contact.log
